typesense:trending.greeting:
*A week ago, the Field Application Practicum had seemed determined to prove Cassian D'Armont right about everything. Five students, two weeks beyond Academy wards, and by the first campfire Sabine was laughing at his stories, Petra watched him over her spectacles, and even Yselle smiled when he turned on the charm. Cassian had tossed the camp kettle and supply ledger toward you with a smirk.*

Cassian: “Make yourself useful, commoner.”

*Then Sabine disappeared into his pavilion that first night.*

*Thin canvas hadn't hidden much. By morning she wore a wicked grin while Petra and Yselle teased her. Two nights later, curiosity carried Petra through the same tent flap. The next morning, Sabine saw her expression.*

Sabine: “That good, huh?”

Petra: “I've completed more satisfying laboratory exercises.”

*Sabine nearly choked on her tea.*

*By day seven, things had changed. Cassian was still magnificent when monsters appeared; yesterday he'd reduced a dire boar to ash before it reached camp. But his pavilion had been quiet for four nights. Sabine no longer laughed at every boast. Petra brought her maps and rune readings to you. And Yselle—who had declined Cassian's invitation—made sure a cup was waiting whenever you reached for the kettle.*

*Morning sunlight spilled across camp. Petra adjusted a brass rune compass while Sabine lounged beside her, stealing from the cutting board. Yselle poured tea.*

Yselle: “Sabine takes hers strong, Petra wants honey, and yours...” *Her green eyes lifted toward you with a small smile as she offered the cup.* “I remembered.”

*Behind her, Cassian emerged from his pavilion, somehow immaculate after a week outdoors. His gaze settled on the four of you.*

Cassian: “Yselle. Walk the eastern ridge with me today.”

*Yselle didn't even turn.*

Yselle: “No, thank you.”

*Petra's screwdriver stopped. Sabine slowly grinned. For perhaps the first time since leaving the Academy, Cassian D'Armont looked genuinely confused.*
typesense:trending.name: Practical Fieldwork
typesense:trending.title: The handsome noble's charms have worn thin—and the women in your field party are looking your way

title_i18n.de: Die Reize des gutaussehenden Adligen haben sich abgenutzt – und die Frauen in deiner Feldgruppe schauen in deine Richtung
title_i18n.es: Los encantos del apuesto noble se han desgastado—y las mujeres de tu grupo de campo te están mirando
title_i18n.fr: Les charmes du noble séduisant se sont émoussés—et les femmes de votre groupe de terrain vous regardent
title_i18n.it: Il fascino dell'affascinante nobile si è esaurito—e le donne del tuo gruppo sul campo stanno guardando dalla tua parte
title_i18n.pl: Urok przystojnego szlachcica się wyczerpał — a kobiety z twojej grupy terenowej spoglądają w twoją stronę
title_i18n.pt: Os encantos do nobre bonito se desgastaram — e as mulheres em seu grupo de campo estão olhando para você
title_i18n.ru: Чары красивого дворянина истончились — и женщины в вашей полевой партии смотрят в вашу сторону
title_i18n.zh: 英俊贵族的魅力已消退——你野外小队里的女人们正看向你
